title: Visual Identity / Kit-of-Parts
slide_intent: Show the identity’s ingredients together so designers can see how distinct elements form a recognizable family.
strategic_value: The warm palette, rounded type, food imagery and illustration can reinforce one Burger King character across formats.
demonstration: A left introduction faces a three-by-three matrix of logo, wordmark, color, type, icons, lockup, illustration, illustrated type and food photography.
practical_value: Inventory the available ingredient types before choosing which a particular application needs.

content_islands.name: Introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the kit explanation in the left quarter.

content_islands.name: Signature row
content_islands.spec: Use the upper row for logo, wordmark and palette.

content_islands.name: Graphic row
content_islands.spec: Use the middle row for type, icons and a signature lockup.

content_islands.name: Image row
content_islands.spec: Use the bottom row for illustration, shaped lettering and food photography.

reference_purposes.Expression: The matrix brings the distinct visual ingredients into one coordinated overview.
reference_purposes.Application: The labels identify the toolkit parts available to build identity applications.
